question: General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade was formalised in the year:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1947**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• The General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) was a legal agreement minimizing barriers to international trade by eliminating or reducing quotas, tariffs, and subsidies while preserving significant regulations.

• GATT was signed on 30 October 1947 by 23 nations and took effect on 1 January 1948.

• The agreement was signed in Geneva, Switzerland, and aimed to boost economic recovery after World War II.

• GATT remained in effect until it was replaced by the World Trade Organization (WTO) on 1 January 1995.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT)**

• GATT was created to form a common institutional framework for the conduct of international trade relations concerning goods.

• It was designed to provide an enduring basis for international trade and economic cooperation.

• GATT's primary objective was to reduce barriers to trade by eliminating discriminatory treatment in international commerce.

• The agreement aimed to promote international trade and economic prosperity by reducing tariffs and other trade barriers.

• **World Trade Organization (WTO)**

• The WTO is an intergovernmental organization that regulates and facilitates international trade between nations.

• Officially commenced on 1 January 1995, replacing the GATT.

• It provides a forum for negotiating trade agreements, a dispute resolution process, and serves as a place to settle trade disputes.

• The WTO has 164 member countries as of 2021, representing over 98% of global trade.

• **Tariffs**

• A tariff is a tax imposed by a government on imported goods.

• Tariffs are used to restrict imports by increasing the price of goods and services purchased from another country, making them less attractive to domestic consumers.

• They are one of the oldest forms of protectionism and are used to protect domestic industries from foreign competition.

• **Quotas**

• A quota is a government-imposed trade restriction that limits the number or monetary value of goods that a country can import or export during a particular period.

• Quotas are used to benefit the producers of a good in that economy.

• They are often used in international trade to control the volume of trade between countries.
